Oh man… {{wi}}We are walking in complete silence for a few minutes now…{{wi}} This is embarrassing…
I knew this was a bad idea, but I can’t really tell him that in the face.
Shit…{{wi}} I need to come up with some topic. Anything!
…
You: Um, Mr. Landlord.
Landlord: Yes?
You: That’s a lot of groceries you got there. Is someone visiting you?
Landlord: I don’t know. Maybe my daughter will come to see me this time. Can’t say for sure.
Landlord: I always buy a little more when she has vacations and stuff.
Landlord: But the main reason is that a few days ago my bag broke and some people took my stuff!
